verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe self-hosting the Letta App Server on infrastructure you control (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-15/38), local mode storing state on-device without login (letta-docs-31), and a runtime probe confirms the App Server actually boots keylessly with agent state kept on-device (letta-probe-rt-2). This directly satisfies self-hosting the memory layer via open-source code. Missing for 10: explicit Docker-specific instructions/Dockerfile evidence and independent third-party confirmation of a Docker-based deployment.
